h1: Green@Buriram — a little garden hotel guests keep praising for being clean and quiet
intro: If you want a low-cost stay in Buriram that is clean, quiet and feels like a green garden rather than a roadside block of rooms, Green@Buriram is a small hotel of around 20 rooms on the bypass road that earns surprisingly high review scores for its level · Expect 20 sqm garden-view rooms, breakfast cooked fresh to order, free parking, and a location just 3-4 km from Chang Arena · From approx. ฿1,100/night.

body.html: What sets Green@Buriram apart from the usual budget stay is its atmosphere · Instead of rooms lined up in a roadside block, this is a small hotel of around 20 rooms arranged around a quiet green garden · It sits on the bypass road, Moo 1, Mueang Buriram District · The location is not in the heart of the shopping streets, but it is only a short drive into town or out to Chang Arena, which suits self-drivers who want a genuinely restful base.

Rooms are Garden View, around 20 sqm, on the first and second floors with a view over the garden · Each has air-conditioning, a TV, fridge, kettle, hot-water shower and the basics covered · The thing guests mention most is cleanliness — many reviews describe both the bedroom and bathroom as spotless · The rooms are not large, but they are tidy, comfortable to sleep in, and quiet thanks to the small room count and the setback from the main road.
"Very clean rooms, a leafy quiet garden, friendly owner and staff, and a breakfast cooked fresh to order that tastes better than the price suggests — we come back every time we visit Buriram."

Breakfast at Cafe@Green is another point that comes up often in praise · It is not a self-serve buffet but à la carte, cooked fresh to order, with both Thai and Western dishes served alongside fresh fruit · Many reviews note the taste and the pleasure of eating out in the garden · There are also small touches like welcome cookies and drinks that make it feel like the owner cares · Wi-Fi is strong and reaches throughout, and there is free on-site parking, which matters a lot for people driving to Buriram.

On location, let's be honest · Green@Buriram is not within walking distance of Chang Arena · The stadium is about 3-4 km away, a few minutes by car, and Chang International Circuit is roughly 6-7 km · If your main aim is football or racing and you want to walk to the venue, this may not be your first pick · But if you are driving and value cleanliness, quiet and a good breakfast over walking distance, this kind of location works well.

The limitations to know: Green@Buriram is a small property with no swimming pool, no lift, and a limited number of rooms · A few reviews mention music from bars or venues nearby on some nights, and one guest noted an air-conditioning leak that affected their sleep · The overall picture is still strongly positive, but anyone wanting full resort-style facilities should expect a place that focuses on being simple, clean and warm rather than luxurious.

Overall, Green@Buriram is a good fit for self-drivers visiting Buriram who want a clean, quiet, affordable stay · A score of 9.6 from 59 reviews on Trip.com is very high for this class and reflects guest satisfaction with cleanliness, service and breakfast · Rates start from around ฿1,100/night for a garden-view room, and because there are so few rooms, book ahead during big match days or race weekends.

honestSummary: Green@Buriram is a great fit for self-drivers who want a clean, quiet room with a good breakfast at a budget price · The trade-offs to accept are that it is a small hotel with no pool, few rooms, and no walking distance to Chang Arena.
honestChecks: If your main goal is to walk to Chang Arena or the racetrack — it is about 3-4 km away and needs a drive → if you want to walk to the venue, look at hotels in the Samet area beside the stadium instead.
If you want full resort-style facilities — this is a small hotel with no swimming pool and no lift → for a pool or gym, choose a higher-tier property.
If your dates fall on a big match day or a race weekend — there are very few rooms and they fill fast → book ahead and lock in a free-cancellation rate first.

faq.q: How far is Green@Buriram from Chang Arena?
faq.a: The hotel is on the bypass road, Moo 1, Mueang Buriram District, about 3-4 km from Chang Arena, roughly an 8-minute drive · Chang International Circuit is around 6-7 km away · It is not walkable to the stadium, but it is convenient for self-drivers and has free parking.

faq.q: How much does Green@Buriram cost and what rooms are available?
faq.a: Rates start from around ฿1,100/night for a Garden View room of about 20 sqm · There are both queen-bed and twin-bed garden-view options · Prices rise on big match days and race weekends, so compare a few platforms before you book.

faq.q: Does Green@Buriram serve breakfast, and what is it like?
faq.a: Yes — breakfast at Cafe@Green is à la carte, cooked fresh to order, with both Thai and Western dishes served alongside fresh fruit · It is one of the things guests praise most, for both the taste and the experience of eating in the garden.

It is a great fit for self-drivers visiting Buriram who want a clean, quiet, affordable stay focused on garden atmosphere and a good breakfast rather than full facilities · If you want to walk to Chang Arena or need a swimming pool, there may be a better-suited option.

faq.q: Is there anything to watch out for before booking Green@Buriram?
faq.a: It is a small hotel with no swimming pool, no lift, and only around 20 rooms · A few reviews mention music from nearby bars on some nights and an air-conditioning leak in one room · It is not walkable to the stadium, so you'll need to drive · Overall, though, the score is high and the praise for cleanliness and service stands out.
